messages.subject: Planned maintenance: document management system (Sat 29 March)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The firm's document management system (FileSite) will be unavailable on Saturday 29 March between 06:00 and 12:00 for scheduled maintenance. Please save and close any documents before Friday close of business. There is no action required for cloud mailboxes. Apologies for any inconvenience.

IT Helpdesk
